brief: A calendar showing energy levels — mornings are high ground, post-lunch dips are valleys

dominant_strengths: Clean header hierarchy and readable sans-serif type pair well with generous calendar grid spacing.
Legend-to-bar color mapping is consistent, giving an at-a-glance taxonomy across all cells.
dominant_weaknesses: Four near-identical mini-bars per day read as abstract noise, not a 'rhythm' — temporal shape of the day is invisible.
Saturated green/orange/red traffic-light palette feels generic and emotionally flat for an energy/wellness theme.
No axis, time labels, or curve metaphor — the brief's 'mornings high, post-lunch valleys' narrative is not legible.
fix_priorities: Replace the four discrete bars with a continuous sparkline/area curve so peaks and valleys are spatially obvious.
Soften the palette to a single hue gradient (energy intensity) rather than categorical traffic-light colors.
Add subtle time-of-day ticks (AM/noon/PM) under each cell to anchor the rhythm metaphor.
Introduce a weekly aggregate row or hover detail to support reflective comparison.
rationale.norman_balance: Mildly visceral via color, but behavioral clarity is weak and reflective insight is minimal — the chart shows data without revealing pattern.
rationale.intent_fit: Only partially — it tracks four energy buckets per day but fails to visually express the morning-peak / afternoon-valley rhythm at the heart of the brief.
